clips.title: The story
paras: Bingles' Blastencapper is a specialized explosive device designed by the gnome pilot Bingles Blastenheimer. Lost when his gyrocopter plunged into the Loch, it was stolen by local troggs, endangering Bingles' plans to support the liberation of Gnomeregan.

Bingles' Blastencapper represents the peak of pilot Bingles Blastenheimer's personal ordnance. Built to deliver decisive aerial strikes against the troggs and leper gnomes overruning Gnomeregan, the explosive was aboard his gyrocopter when mechanical failure sent him plummeting into the waters of the Loch. While Bingles survived, troggs infesting the lake's northern islands pillaged his wreckage and dragged the volatile weapon back to their camps.

To Bingles, the Blastencapper is far more than simple salvage. The exiled gnomes are actively preparing to take back their radioactive home, and Bingles considers his gyrocopter and signature munitions vital components of the impending air assault. Recovering this ordnance prevents the indigenous troggs of Loch Modan from accidentally triggering a catastrophe and preserves a valuable weapon for the gnomish resistance.
